title: Avengers vs. X-Men
subtitle: The Phoenix returns and two teams collide
intro: The 2012 AvX conflict. Schism and X-Sanction are optional context; the main #0–12 series tells the central story. VS expands fights and does not replace the main issues. Read Consequences after the finale before moving into the new team era. Tie-in placements vary across guides; the optional VS recipe follows the linked Herald order and keeps the two series clearly distinct.

steps.title: Schism: why the X-Men are divided
steps.why: Optional background on the Cyclops/Wolverine split before AvX.
steps.match: The Schism collection includes the five-part split. It is not a substitute for AvX itself.

steps.title: Avengers: X-Sanction
steps.why: Cable and Hope context immediately before AvX.
steps.match: No confirmed full X-Sanction collection match in the supplied catalog. An isolated first issue in a sampler would not complete this four-part setup.

steps.title: Avengers vs. X-Men — the complete main series
steps.why: Start with #0, then read #1–12 for the complete central conflict.
steps.match: This is the confirmed #0–12 catalog edition. The older ISBN 9780785179948 has an existing contents discrepancy in local enrichment and is not offered as an equivalent here.

steps.title: VS: optional expanded battles
steps.why: Individual matchups expand battles already in the main series. Skip this branch without losing the central plot.
steps.match: The VS volume contains the six side-fight issues plus A-Babies vs. X-Babies, a separate playful extra. Borrow the main event separately.

steps.title: AvX: Consequences
steps.why: The direct epilogue follows the fallout, especially for Cyclops. Read after main-series #12.
steps.match: Avengers vs. X-Men Companion includes Consequences #1–5 among many parallel tie-ins. Jump to Consequences for this step; do not read the whole companion before #12 because it contains aftermath spoilers.

steps.title: Next era: Uncanny Avengers
steps.why: The Unity Squad is a new ongoing direction after AvX, not an extra chapter required to complete it.
steps.match: The Red Shadow starts the successor series. Read after Consequences for this guided path, though the new series began publication during the epilogue’s release.
